### docs\DECISIONS.md
```
h1 Decisions
h2 ADR-028 — BallisticAim computes the needed elevation; no high-arc pick and no Range
h2 ADR-027 — Play Mode sheet can add and remove modifiers on the working copy
h2 ADR-026 — GroundField views come from a factory
h2 ADR-025 — Package id is `com.veerdonk.projectile-system`
h2 ADR-024 — Sample scene is the Play Mode demo; turret stays in Assets
h2 ADR-023 — Recipes are authored as ScriptableObjects; Spawn still takes Recipe
h2 ADR-022 — GroundField is a planted disk, not a Recipe
h2 ADR-021 — Views come from a factory; hits stay a sphere
h2 ADR-020 — Protection is a collider marker, not HP
h2 ADR-019 — Ballistic aim is a fire-time helper, not a path
h2 ADR-018 — Gravity(n) scales instance gravity, like Speed
h2 ADR-017 — Recipe.Gravity is a motion stat, default 0
h2 ADR-016 — AreaEffect overlaps Targets; area damage is not Recipe.Damage
h2 ADR-015 — Multiply places children through `IMultiplyPattern`
h2 ADR-014 — Stat modifiers are scales; Spread(n) scales Multiply spacing
h2 ADR-013 — Combat and cast numbers are Recipe stats
h2 ADR-012 — One interval per instance, set by `Interval(n)` on `OnSpawn`
h2 ADR-011 — Status is a hit request, not package combat
h2 ADR-010 — Homing retargets after a Target hit; Bounce reflects Target too
h2 ADR-009 — Homing acquires once, then steers
h2 ADR-008 — Prewarm follows spawn chains
h2 ADR-007 — Chain depth is Recipe data, counted down
h2 ADR-006 — Multicast aims through a pattern
h2 ADR-005 — Hybrid ECS for live instances
```
